input_provenance.derived_by: every authored (non-L0) level of all 54 runs in data/, one call per level
input_provenance.note: inputs.jsonl stores a pointer and a sha1 rather than the prompt text, which lives in data/. verify-inputs re-derives the level set from MANIFEST.json and re-hashes each file.

note: Outputs are the primary record of what the annotator said, not a cache. The script sets no temperature, so the runs used the API default; they are not reproducible by rerunning.
